name: @streamshare/tv-client
description: Open source Streamshare remote playback receiver for Windows, macOS and Linux

scripts.start:debug: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-host-ffmpeg.mjs && node scripts/start-debug.mjs
scripts.dist:host: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs mac arm64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=-
scripts.dist:mac:x64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs mac x64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=-
scripts.dist:win:x64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs win x64 && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:arm64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs win x64 && electron-builder --win nsis zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs linux x64 && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs linux arm64 && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:signed:mac:arm64: node scripts/assert-signing-env.mjs mac && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs mac arm64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.notarize=true
scripts.dist:signed:mac:x64: node scripts/assert-signing-env.mjs mac && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs mac x64 && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true -c.mac.notarize=true
scripts.dist:signed:win:x64: node scripts/assert-signing-env.mjs win && pnpm build && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs win x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=true
